39	def discover_all_memory_systems() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
40	    """Auto-discover all memory system .py files on disk."""
41	    base = Path(__file__).parent
42	    systems = []
43	    for f in sorted((base / "agents").glob("*.py")):
44	        name = f.stem
45	        if name in _SKIP_MEMORY_FILES:
46	            continue
47	        systems.append((name, f"agents/{name}.py"))
48	    return systems
49

53	    o = _DS_OVERRIDES.get(dataset, {})
